title: The Homecoming of Cedar Falls
author: F. M. Montrose
blurb: Silas Winterbourne, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must expose what the school board buried before prom.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
